title: File:A rainy day on Iberville Street, New Orleans Umbrella.jpg
desc:
Rainy day on Iberville Street, New Orleans French Quarter.
With An Event Apart NOLA over, it was time for winding down in New Orleans. 
Even the heavy rain couldn't dampen spirits, although it dampened just about everything else.

(I'm often amazed how good the crappy iPhone camera can sometimes be)
